summary.content:
Today's selection covers 69 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 43 on Artificial Intelligence and 11 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Rogue Behavior: OpenAI Reveals More Model Misalignment Incidents
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: CrowdSec Confirms Source Code Stolen in Supply Chain Attack
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from Dark Reading, The Verge, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 34 articles published in the last 24 hours
